values.note: 9 single sites, each with a picnic table and fire grate. Most mature pines were removed after the beetle kill, so there is little shade.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/hidden-lakes-campground ('offers 9 single campsites'; 'Campsites can accommodate trailers up to 50 feet in length'; 'MAX TRAILER LENGTH: 50 ft.'), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/hidden-lakes-campground ('No potable water or electric hook ups'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: No trash service: pack out all trash.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/hidden-lakes-campground ('The campground offers a vault toilet and there is no potable water available'; 'There are no trash services at this campground'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Mid-June to mid-October, both weather dependent; at 8,900 ft, expect freezing nights and possible summer snow.

note: Routt NF campground beside a small mountain lake at ~8,900 ft, 32 mi southwest of Walden, near several small lakes and a reservoir (trout; no motorized boats). Access: CO 14 to Hebron, County Road 24 west (becomes Forest Road 60 at the forest boundary), then Forest Road 20 south ~6 mi; the FS gives no high-clearance warning. --Claude
